stemMd: A rectangular block spans x = 0 to 8, y = 0 to 3 and z = 0 to 5. It is viewed orthographically along the positive y direction. What are the dimensions of its silhouette in the xz-plane?
explanationMd: Viewing along y collapses depth. The visible horizontal span is the x-range, eight units, and the vertical span is the z-range, five units. The block’s three-unit depth does not affect that silhouette.

distractorRationale.e: This uses the plan depth instead of height.
distractorRationale.d: This describes the side view along x.
distractorRationale.c: Depth and height do not add in orthographic projection.
distractorRationale.b: Neither visible span is the y-span.
